summary.text: Lisa Davey is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 67, facing Republican incumbent G. Murrell Smith Jr. in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described 24 years of military service followed by about ten years of work helping formerly incarcerated people return to their communities.

paragraphs.text: Lisa Davey served in the U.S. Army from 1981 to 2005.
Davey graduated from Lindsborg High School, earned a bachelor's degree from Kansas State University in 1988 and a graduate degree from Webster University in 1992, and attended Walden University.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Davey said that after her military service she spent another ten years on reentry work in South Carolina, worked at the Sumter Police Department as a digital forensic analyst, and served at the Richland County Sheriff's Department as operations manager for the 911 transition.
She also listed service as a public member commissioner in South Carolina and as the Sumter County Democratic Party executive committeewoman.
Davey's survey responses named crime reduction and public safety, quality education and workforce readiness, and women's reproductive rights and personal freedoms as her key campaign messages.
She also listed second chances for formerly incarcerated people as a policy area of personal passion.
